summaries.default: Full-stack developer and Magna Cum Laude BSIT graduate based in Cebu City. I build modern web applications end-to-end—clean UI, reliable APIs, and maintainable architecture—with a focus on shipping useful software.
summaries.fullstack: Full-stack developer specializing in Next.js, Supabase, and Node-based backends. I design and ship production web apps from UI through data layer, with attention to clean architecture, performance, and maintainable code.
summaries.frontend: Frontend-focused developer building polished, accessible interfaces with React, Next.js, and Tailwind. I care about clear UX, motion that supports hierarchy, and component systems that stay maintainable as products grow.
summaries.backend: Backend-capable full-stack developer experienced with Node.js, Express, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL. I build APIs, data models, and service layers that keep applications reliable and easy to operate.
summaries.technical-support: Technical support professional and BSIT graduate with hands-on experience maintaining campus IT infrastructure. Strong troubleshooting foundation (PC, networking) plus development background that helps bridge users, systems, and software teams.
summaries.software-engineer: Software engineer and Magna Cum Laude BSIT graduate who builds full-stack web systems with React/Next.js and modern backends. Comfortable owning features from requirements through deployment.
summaries.web-developer: Web developer building responsive, production-ready sites and apps with Next.js, Tailwind, and modern tooling. Experienced delivering product UIs, marketing sites, and full-stack features for real stakeholders.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
